item.title: Version 1.4.419
item.description: - **The update hold now answers only the updater, and says so when it can't.** Pausing Story before the Launcher replaces it is how an update never cuts off work — but anything else on the Mac could pause it too, and an answer of "not now" was being read as "go ahead". The hold now needs the updater's private token, a file only you can read: without it Story refuses, nothing is paused, it keeps doing its work, and the refusal names the file to fix. Any other kind of request is answered as unsupported instead of quietly doing nothing.
